backend/main.mo: Actor manages vehicles and user favorites with add, toggle, query, and filtering functions using Map and Set structures.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old Int‑keyed vehicle/favorite data to Nat‑keyed structures and producing a new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping frontend files to implemented features, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend file paths to short human‑written summaries used for build and documentation reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining a racing‑inspired color system for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing root div and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes including Add Vehicle page and wraps the app with theme and toaster providers.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout component rendering header, footer, and routed page content.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button using Internet Identity with login, logout, and principal display.
frontend/src/components/ErrorState.tsx: Reusable error card component with retry support.
frontend/src/components/FavoriteButton.t: Favorite toggle button handling auth checks and updating favorite state via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with site links, social icons, and a dynamic year including caffeine.ai referral link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with responsive navigation, mobile menu, logo, and authentication button.
frontend/src/components/LoadingState.tsx: Skeleton-based loading components for vehicle cards, grids, and detail views.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wrapper enforcing authentication, showing loading or sign-in prompt when needed.
frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx: Displays a vehicle preview with image, specs, type badge, and favorite button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFavorites.ts: Hooks for fetching, checking, toggling, and loading favorite vehicles using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and lifecycle handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for organizing queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useVehicle.ts: Fetches a single vehicle by ID using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVehicles.ts: Hooks for fetching all vehicles or filtering them by type.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind configuration defining light/dark themes with racing-inspired color variables.
frontend/src/lib/formatters.ts: Utility functions for formatting bigint and numeric values into human-readable speed, weight, and acceleration strings.
frontend/src/lib/vehicleTypes.ts: Defines vehicle types and provides helpers for category labels and icon paths.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing VehicleHub and its features.
frontend/src/pages/AddVehiclePage.tsx: Form page allowing users to validate input and submit new vehicle data to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays vehicles filtered by type with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/FavoritesPage.tsx: Authenticated page showing the user's favorited vehicles with standard loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page featuring hero content, category navigation, and a preview of featured vehicles.
frontend/src/pages/VehicleDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information, images, and specs for a single vehicle with formatting and navigation controls.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling custom OKLCH color theme, container settings, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current app features, requirements, and state for a vehicle enthusiast app.
